subject: Invest in Medford Ballot Questions
overview: Medford city and school officials held a campaign town hall to present ballot Questions 6, 7, and 8 regarding municipal funding, school staffing, and a new fire headquarters. Panelists detailed the city's fiscal constraints under Proposition 2 1/2 and answered public questions on tax impacts, budget transparency, and municipal services.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Overview of Ballot Questions
items.summary: Host Jessica introduced the meeting format before panelists presented Medford's financial landscape under Proposition 2 1/2 and introduced ballot Questions 6, 7, and 8.

items.title: Discussion of Free Cash and Commercial New Growth
items.summary: Panelists defined municipal free cash, explained capital reserve requirements, detailed local infrastructure backlogs, and reviewed recent commercial development trends.

items.title: Question 6 Overview: Fire Headquarters Debt Exclusion
items.summary: Panelists explained the mechanics of Proposition 2 1/2 debt exclusions and outlined the $30 million proposal to build a new city fire headquarters.

items.title: Questions 7 and 8 Overview: Municipal and School Overrides
items.summary: Panelists outlined the operating budget proposals for Question 7 to maintain school personnel and establish a dedicated DPW road crew, and Question 8 to extend school instruction time.

items.title: Public Q&A on Financial Planning, City Services, and Tax Impacts
items.summary: Panelists and additional local officials answered community questions regarding financial task force history, grant funding limitations, tax implementation schedules, senior exemptions, and private road maintenance.
